title: DataSourceReferencesResponse
description: Response body for GET /api/data-sources/references (HEL-1258): the reference summary of every data source the caller OWNS that has at least one reference, using the same reference kinds and visibility as the DELETE /api/data-sources/:id 409 body (HEL-1252). `pipelines` and `panels` list ONLY referencing resources the caller can see; hidden ones contribute only the counts, never an id or name. A source with no reference, or one the caller does not own, is absent.

hiddenPipelineCount.description: Referencing pipelines the caller cannot see: a COUNT only, never an identity.

hiddenPanelCount.description: Referencing form panels the caller cannot see: a COUNT only, never an identity.
